prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: single character reference for 3D modeling.
The input is our APPROVED 2x2 animal roster sheet. Extract and faithfully reproduce ONLY the TOP LEFT male chef cat, as one full-body character centered on a plain white background. Remove all other figures and labels.
Preserve exactly the approved character identity: huge round head, short broad muzzle, tiny dark animal eyes with no white sclera, small body, extremely short connected legs, tiny animal feet, short connected arms and fingerless mitten paws. Preserve species colors, ears and tail. Clothing: ivory toque with indigo band, indigo neckerchief, ivory double-breasted jacket and short waist apron with indigo trim, cocoa shorts. Keep all distinctive accessories obvious and proportional exactly as reference.
Change pose only: directly front-facing, arms gently spread sideways/downward about 40 degrees from body in a clear riggable A-pose; paws separated from torso, feet slightly separated. Do NOT lengthen legs or add human fingers, shoes, human eyes, eyelashes or a long snout. No props, text, multiple views or scenery. Keep full hat and feet inside frame with white margin. Soft matte smooth 3D toy-like surface with even neutral studio light, no cast shadow. One character only.
